title: Witches Sailing to Dark Castle
description: A surreal fantasy scene depicts three wooden boats with red spiral sails carrying green-skinned witches across a body of water with glowing red concentric ripples. In the foreground a blue-clad witch kneels on a stone dock before a glowing blue runic cube. A massive dark castle with dragon-like towers and glowing pink windows dominates the right side, while ethereal pink spirits, black tree-like figures, and floating celestial orbs fill the swirling orange and purple sky.
prompt: A surreal fantasy painting shows several boats with red spiral sails carrying green witches across red rippling water toward a massive gothic castle with dragon architecture and glowing pink windows. A blue witch kneels on a stone pier activating a glowing blue rune cube. Ethereal pink female spirits and black tree-like shadow figures float in the air. The sky is a swirling vortex of orange and purple with multiple suns, moons, and celestial bodies. Butterflies and magical particles fill the scene.
